g.text: LCAnet—Modular Ontology ArchitectureSix decoupled OWL 2 DL modules · Core as semantic integration hub
act: ActivityClasses & properties· ComposedActivity· SequencedActivity· Flow (Elementary / Intermediate)· hasActivityPart
SWRL rule exampleComposedActivity(?A),Flow(?F), hasActivityPart(?A,?B),isInputProductOf(?F,?B), Activity (?B)→ isInputProductOf(?F,?A)(flow propagation via ComposedActivity)
actor: ActorClasses & properties· Agent· Role· Responsibility· playsRole · entailsResponsibilityODP: Agent Role pattern
SWRL ruleAgent(?A), playsRole(?A,?R),Role(?R), entailsResp(?R,?X),Responsibility(?X)→ bearsResponsibility(?A,?X)(responsibility inference)
st: SpatiotemporalTemporal (reuses OWL Time)· TimeInstant · TimeInterval· DurationDescription

Spatial (reuses GeoNames & Schema)· Location (≡ gn:Feature,schema:Place)--Site--AdministrativeRegion· SpatialPlace--Local · Regional--National · GlobalSpatial granularity for LCA scopedefinition per ISO 14040
ia: Impact AssessmentClasses & properties· ImpactCategory· ImpactResult· ImpactIndicator· CharacterisationFactor· EF Method (EF 3.0)
SWRL rulehasImpactCategory(?A,?C),ImpactCategory(?C),containedIn(?O,?A),LCAResult(?A), OverallImpact(?O)→ hasImpactCategory(?O,?C)(impact category aggregation)to overall LCA result
